top_signals.title: Gold Falls as Traders Weigh US Inflation
top_signals.summary: Gold valuation platform Unvault estimates that American households are sitting on $750 Billion worth of gold, largely in the form of unworn jewelry. The company says consumers consistently underestimate their jewelry's spot value by 3x or more because pieces purchased prior to 2010 have more than tripled in value. CEO Nidhi Singhvi joins Businessweek Daily to discuss how her business is being boosting by higher gold prices in 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Revolution's Hall On Investing in the Defense Sector
top_signals.summary: David Hall, managing partner at Revolution, talks about investing in the defense sector and backing Hermeus, a company looking to build a hyper-sonic military jet. He speaks with Romaine Bostick at the Bloomberg New Voices event in Martha's Vineyard. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
